title: Everyday Market from Woolworths: 20% Cashback on $200.01+ Spend (Uncapped) @ TopCashback AU
body:
Deal: Everyday Market from Woolworths: 20% Cashback on $200.01+ Spend (Uncapped) @ TopCashback AU

[tightarse] Hey guys. This promo was not meant to be live, but a glitch set it live from midnight and has now been expired . A new promo may start at 10AM but the rate and length is yet to be determined. More to come later if/when I know more.
Please note that all purchases made from midnight AEDT up to 3:45AM AEDT (17/10/2026) will be honoured at the full 20% and have already been corrected in your accounts.
Apologies for the error, and have a lovely weekend :)
[Wiadro] To spend $201 at Woolies I’d need to be really rich.
[MyMumThinksImCool] It's the third-party Marketplace, not the supermarket.
[frewer] Me too, my rent will increase 7% next year 😭thanks RBA
[plmko] So buy property. Saw an ok 4br house $800k —> $720k -> $650k (sold).
No excuses.
[sydney rider] 1+ years ago, I bought a PS5 Disc for $438 down from $638 with $200 ShopBack.
Now prices are so jacked up, I can't buy the Switch 2 I've been eyeing.
[A female dog] FWIW, they’ve got iPhone 18 pro max available at rrp
[BargainBenno] Not the 256 g version. But yes the 512 they do.
[Ranike] Need to spend over $750 to make uncapped at 20% worthwhile. Otherwise better to wait for $150 cap at 30%.
[hungry analyst] I'm hoping the $150 cap at 30% comes back this weekend.
[coldazure] hard to hit above $750 to make this worthwhile. come on 30% uncapped let's gooo!!

iphone 18 pro max 512gb for $2154 after cashback
